# This is a POC for a 10 minute delivery app.
## Core Features
### Product Catalog
Display a fixed inventory of products with names, images, prices, and available quantities
Allow users to browse and search through the product catalog
Shopping Cart
Enable users to add products to cart with desired quantities
Allow quantity adjustments and item removal
Display cart summary with itemized list and total price
Order Placement
Simple checkout process without payment integration
Collect delivery address information
Order confirmation with unique order ID
Delivery Tracking
Start a 10-minute countdown timer upon order placement
Display mock delivery status updates (e.g., "Order Confirmed", "Preparing", "Out for Delivery", "Delivered")
Show mock delivery confirmation when timer completes
Technical Requirements
Responsive UI web
local state management for cart and order tracking
Timer functionality with background support
User Flow
User browses product catalog
User adds items to cart
User proceeds to checkout
User enters delivery address
User confirms order
Delivery timer starts
Status updates displayed
Mock delivery confirmation shown after 10 minutes
